$comment: Single source of every number this skill reasons with. Two groups: (1) values MIRRORED from makeseo's own SEO knowledge base — do not diverge from the product; (2) analysis defaults the skill applies to raw Search Console / audit data (industry-standard, tune freely). Audit, optimize, write-article and the article validator (scripts/check-article-html.mjs) all read from here — never hard-code a number in prose or code.
mirrors_compendium: SEO-Kompendium – Vom Grundwissen zum Expertenniveau (11 Kapitel, Stand Aug 2026)

onpage_mirrored.$comment: Mirrored 1:1 from the makeseo knowledge base. rule_id is the stable identity in that file; a generated article is measured against these, and the pre-publish quality gate enforces the hard ones.

target_word_count.$comment: makeseo deliberately has NO fixed word-count target — length is derived from what the top results need, then a little beyond. Never assert a word count as a rule.

analysis_defaults.$comment: Applied by the skill's audit/optimize analyses to raw GSC + audit data. Not makeseo product rules — industry benchmarks. Positions are 1-indexed SERP positions.

expected_ctr_by_position.$comment: Rough organic CTR benchmark used only to FLAG under-performing pages, never to promise traffic. Positions beyond 10 assume page 2+.

striking_distance.$comment: Pages in this band already have authority; a meta + internal-link refresh climbs them fastest — the best ROI in an audit.

content_decay.$comment: Flag a page whose clicks fell >= this percent vs the previous equal period. A point-in-time snapshot is NOT a trend — require a real prior period and say so.

brand_share_bands.$comment: >= healthy: non-brand demand is strong. 40–60: moderate. < moderate: traffic is brand-dependent — invest in non-brand content.

cannibalization.$comment: Two ways to detect: group the project's own articles by target keyword, AND read GSC for one query served by multiple pages. Mirrors makeseo rule cannibalization.rules.

cluster.$comment: A pillar + 4–8 supporting articles, exactly one URL owning each cluster's head term. Mirrors makeseo rules cluster.one_url_per_cluster / cluster.completeness.
